title: After photo is the before photo re-uploaded
description: Deep-clean a home-office desk. The worker re-uploads the before photo as the after photo instead of doing the work.

criteria.label: Floor around the desk is clear of dust and marks
Desk surface is wiped, no dust or sticky marks
No wrappers or rubbish visible near the desk

notes: after_1.jpg MUST be a byte copy of this case before_1.jpg (cp before_1.jpg after_1.jpg). Put the code sticky note in the BEFORE frame too so cL can pass. MANUAL §9.5 expects HUMAN_REVIEW; the decision engine only returns HUMAN_REVIEW on a HIGH flag or an uncertain required criterion, so a NO_CHANGE-only case may come out PARTIAL (MEDIUM flag blocks APPROVED) - both are accepted by this label.
